text: Editorâ€™s Foreword Although outsiders may sometimes think that philosophy is one of the less dynamic ï¬elds, solidly rooted in the thought of philosophers of ear- lier days, that is far from the case.
text_raw:
Editorâ€™s Foreword
Although outsiders may sometimes think that philosophy is one of the
less dynamic ï¬elds, solidly rooted in the thought of philosophers of ear-
lier days, that is far from the case.

text: Nothing proves this more emphati- cally than feminist philosophy, a sector which barely existed a few short decades ago and which is steadily growing.
text_raw:
Nothing proves this more emphati-
cally than feminist philosophy, a sector which barely existed a few
short decades ago and which is steadily growing.

text: Unlike other sectors, it is in some ways narrower, focusing on the situation of women but not by any means restricted to women philosophers.
text_raw:
Unlike other sectors,
it is in some ways narrower, focusing on the situation of women but not
by any means restricted to women philosophers.

text: For the moment, most of the activity is limited to North America and Europe, but the bound- aries are gradually expanding.
text_raw:
For the moment, most
of the activity is limited to North America and Europe, but the bound-
aries are gradually expanding.

text: In other ways, it is much broader, having something to say about works of many of the canonical philosophers, sometimes approving, sometimes criticizing, and occasionally appro- priating.
text_raw:
In other ways, it is much broader, having
something to say about works of many of the canonical philosophers,
sometimes approving, sometimes criticizing, and occasionally appro-
priating.

text: By now feminist philosophy is busy contributing to virtually every other branch of philosophy, whether ethics, epistemology, logic, or language, and also to Marxism, environmentalism, and obviously feminism.
text_raw:
By now feminist philosophy is busy contributing to virtually
every other branch of philosophy, whether ethics, epistemology, logic,
or language, and also to Marxism, environmentalism, and obviously
feminism.

text: Historical Dictionary of Feminist Philosophy covers a much longer span than merely the past few decades.
text_raw:

span than merely the past few decades.

text: Indeed, the chronology stretches back to those ancient Greek philosophers who dealt with the relevant issues tangentially, and on to modern philosophers for whom this is the primary concern.

text: Preface There is no one reader for the Historical Dictionary of Feminist Philos- ophy.
text_raw:
Preface
There is no one reader for the Historical Dictionary of Feminist Philos-
ophy.

text: The intended audience is broad, ranging from the casual reader who may simply want a speciï¬c term explained, to students wanting an introduction to the main ideas and roots of feminist philosophy, to professional philosophers exploring the history and subject matter of feminist philosophy.
text_raw:
The intended audience is broad, ranging from the casual reader
who may simply want a speciï¬c term explained, to students wanting
an introduction to the main ideas and roots of feminist philosophy, to
professional philosophers exploring the history and subject matter of
feminist philosophy.

text: The Historical Dictionary of Feminist Philosophy covers both the central ï¬gures and ideas from the historical tradition of philosophy and the central ideas and theories from contemporary feminist philosophy.
text_raw:
The Historical Dictionary of Feminist Philosophy covers both the
central ï¬gures and ideas from the historical tradition of philosophy and
the central ideas and theories from contemporary feminist philosophy.

text: The latter area includes topics that have their roots in critical reactions to, and developments of, the mainstream tradition, such as epistemol- ogy or the philosophy of science; it also includes topics that have been introduced into the philosophical arena through the feminist movement itself, such as abortion and sexuality.
text_raw:
The latter area includes topics that have their roots in critical reactions
to, and developments of, the mainstream tradition, such as epistemol-
ogy or the philosophy of science; it also includes topics that have been
introduced into the philosophical arena through the feminist movement
itself, such as abortion and sexuality.

text: In addition to an account of their subject matter, the entries on contemporary topics often contain a dis- cussion of the origins and development of these topics.
text_raw:
In addition to an account of their
subject matter, the entries on contemporary topics often contain a dis-
cussion of the origins and development of these topics.

text: In deciding which ï¬gures and topics would fall under the admittedly broad umbrella of feminist philosophy, the aim was to remain as ï¬‚exi- ble as possible.
text_raw:
In deciding which ï¬gures and topics would fall under the admittedly
broad umbrella of feminist philosophy, the aim was to remain as ï¬‚exi-
ble as possible.

text: It would be a mistake to identify feminist philosophy solely with the intellectual activities that go on within the academic de- partments of institutions of higher learning.
text_raw:
It would be a mistake to identify feminist philosophy
solely with the intellectual activities that go on within the academic de-
partments of institutions of higher learning.

text: Moreover, given that the notions of feminism and feminist philosophy have changed over time, it is important to allow this to be reï¬‚ected in the selection of entries.
text_raw:
Moreover, given that the
notions of feminism and feminist philosophy have changed over time,
it is important to allow this to be reï¬‚ected in the selection of entries.

text: The purpose, however, is not to introduce controversial areas of femi- nist philosophy, nor to overemphasize areas that are not particularly well established.
text_raw:
The purpose, however, is not to introduce controversial areas of femi-
nist philosophy, nor to overemphasize areas that are not particularly
well established.

text: Moreover, while the feminist political movement played an important role in directing the goals and subject matter of the discipline of feminist philosophy, entries related to feminist theory, and the feminist movement itself, have not dominated the dictionary. xi
